ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low global contrast; surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity dark grey/black pixels with high-intensity white clusters comprising approximately 5-10% of the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark grey base field punctuated by high-contrast white circular rings (rosettes) distributed across both lobes. A distinct, vertical high-intensity linear segment is located in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with a wide opening angle and low relative depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration present along the entire visible boundary; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits deeper, more irregular notches (higher pixel amplitude) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep from the medial notch progressing outward and upward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous discrete circular white ring patterns (diameter ~5-15 pixels) scattered across the ventral surface, with a high-density cluster on the lateral region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent vertical white scratch on the left lobe; several shorter, faint diagonal linear marks visible near the lower boundary of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular protruding masses of biological growth (epibionts/barnacles and algae) attached to the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe biofouling on the lobe tips creates a highly unique, non-biological jagged silhouette that obscures the natural epidermal boundary at the terminal points.
